purpose: Clips whose performance is meant to leave the standing envelope, reviewed frame by frame. The animation review judges them against this intent instead of the category default, and lists them as 'reviewed — intended' rather than passing them silently. Add a clip only after looking at its frames; give what it does and when it was reviewed.
